parameters.name: GatewayType
parameters.description: The type of the gateway. Set this parameter to **1**. **1** indicates iSCSI.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens describe-storage-gateway --ens-region-id cn-beijing-cmcc --gateway-id sgw-0000 --gateway-type 1 --vpc-id n-000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
